items.title: New House Bills Target Data Center Energy Use, Thermal Impacts
items.dek: Rep. Reggie Miller and Democratic sponsors introduced HB 6251 and 6252 on Aug. 26 to require evaluations of electricity demand, water use, cooling systems and heat effects before large data centers can proceed.
items.judge_note: New bills (HB 6251 and 6252) with specific sponsors and date are a concrete development distinct from the already-live 'New Michigan bills' story.
